# SmartVyapari

> We don't sell AI slop. We build systems that save revenue.

SmartVyapari is an AI automation agency based in Ahmedabad, India, serving businesses globally. We engineer end-to-end autonomous systems — custom workflow automations, intelligent voice & WhatsApp agents, AI filmmaking, enterprise knowledge systems (RAG), and strategic automation consulting — that replace repetitive manual tasks and deliver measurable ROI.

## Core Services

- **Custom AI Automation Systems**: End-to-end workflow automation connecting CRMs, databases, email, and internal tools using engines like n8n and Supabase.
- **AI Voice & WhatsApp Agents**: 24/7 human-like conversational agents for inbound/outbound calls, lead qualification, appointment booking, and CRM sync.
- **AI Filmmaking & Video Production**: High-converting cinematic video ads, UGC content, founder avatars, and programmatic video pipelines (Remotion/HyperFrames) produced at a fraction of traditional production costs.
- **AI Agents & Enterprise RAG**: Intelligent agents with retrieval-augmented generation for querying 150+ page enterprise document knowledge bases with source-cited accuracy.
- **AI Strategy & Operations Consulting**: Operations audits, automation opportunity mapping, and ROI prioritization before writing code.

## Target Customers

- Small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) suffering from manual operational bottlenecks.
- B2B sales teams needing autonomous lead qualification, instant response times, and automated CRM hygiene.
- E-commerce & retail brands needing automated order routing, multi-channel inventory reconciliation, and 24/7 customer support.
- Content creators & digital agencies scaling video production and brand partnership pipelines.

## Positioning & Philosophy

- **Systems, not slop**: We reject generic wrapper tools, superficial prompts, and brittle no-code shortcuts. Every build is tailored, reliable, and integrated directly into production stacks.
- **Measurable ROI first**: We map estimated hours and revenue saved before initiating any build.
- **Production-grade reliability**: Built with robust engineering practices using Claude Code, n8n, Supabase, PostgreSQL, React, and vector databases.
